nodes.author: Anmol Verma
nodes.rationale: Personal software engineering portfolio built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, and shadcn/ui on Base UI primitives, featuring inlined section content and privacy-first configurable resume links.

nodes.author: Hashir Shoaib

nodes.label: components.json Configuration
nodes.rationale: Stores project-level shadcn configuration including primitive base (radix or base), visual style, Tailwind paths, iconLibrary, import aliases, and custom registries.

nodes.label: OKLCH Semantic CSS Variable Tokens
nodes.rationale: Uses background/foreground paired CSS variables in OKLCH color space so changing a single variable updates all referencing components across light and dark modes.

nodes.label: shadcn CLI Reference
nodes.rationale: Documents CLI commands (init, apply, add, search, view, docs, info, build), templates, and preset resolution rules read from components.json.

nodes.label: Customization & Theming Guide
nodes.rationale: Explains semantic CSS variable tokens in OKLCH format, dark mode via .dark class, Tailwind v3/v4 token registration, and component variant extension via cva.

nodes.label: The Design System Page Guide
nodes.rationale: Defines the structure and principles for rendering a comprehensive design system showcase page covering foundations, component tiers, pinned state matrices, edge cases, and recipes.

nodes.label: Design Systems from DESIGN.md Workflow
nodes.rationale: End-to-end workflow for scaffolding a shadcn app from a preset or style, mapping DESIGN.md tokens and typography utilities, restyling component cva variants, and verifying coverage.

nodes.label: shadcn MCP Server Reference
nodes.rationale: Documents the Model Context Protocol server tools for searching, listing, viewing, and auditing registry items across configured and GitHub registries.

nodes.label: Registry Authoring and Addresses Reference
nodes.rationale: Specifies source vs built registries, modular include rules, item definitions, registryDependencies address schemes, and commit-SHA resolution for GitHub registries.

nodes.label: Base UI vs Radix UI API Rules
nodes.norm_label: base ui vs radix ui api rules
nodes.rationale: Contrasts Base UI and Radix UI component APIs in shadcn/ui, including render vs asChild, nativeButton={false}, Select items prop, ToggleGroup, Slider, and Accordion.

nodes.label: Chat & Messaging Primitives Rules
nodes.rationale: Enforces composing conversation UIs from MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment, Marker, Trace, and CodeBlock primitives with built-in streaming and scroll anchoring.

nodes.label: Component Composition Rules
nodes.rationale: Enforces structural composition rules such as placing items inside Group components, accessible titles on overlays, full Card anatomy, and base-appropriate Toast notifications.

nodes.label: Forms & Inputs Rules
nodes.rationale: Standardizes form layouts using FieldGroup, Field, InputGroup, ToggleGroup, FieldSet, and paired data-invalid/aria-invalid validation attributes.

nodes.label: Icons Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Requires importing icons from the configured iconLibrary, using data-icon attributes inside Button, omitting manual icon sizing classes, and passing icons as component objects.

nodes.label: Styling & Tailwind Rules
nodes.rationale: Enforces semantic color tokens, built-in variants, layout-only className usage, flex gap spacing instead of space-y-*, size-* shorthand, cn() utility, and shimmer/scroll-fade utilities.

nodes.label: shadcn/ui Skill
nodes.rationale: Manages shadcn components and projects including adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI with source-code components via the CLI.

nodes.label: Pinned Interaction State Matrix (data-preview)
nodes.rationale: Pins hover, focus-visible, and active interaction states via data-preview attributes so reviewers can inspect all variant states side by side without manual interaction.

nodes.label: Type Scale @utility Classes (type-*)
nodes.rationale: Uses @utility type-* classes instead of --text-* theme keys because tailwind-merge in cn() treats unknown text-* classes as color utilities and drops them when paired with text-muted-foreground.

nodes.label: GitHub Registry Commit SHA Resolution
nodes.rationale: Resolves branch or tag refs to a 40-character commit SHA via git ls-remote before fetching raw.githubusercontent.com files to avoid stale CDN cache snapshots.

nodes.label: Preset Switching Workflow
nodes.rationale: Offers overwrite, partial, merge, or skip modes when switching presets so users can preserve local component customizations or selectively update themes and fonts.

nodes.label: Component Smart Merge Workflow
nodes.rationale: Uses CLI --dry-run and --diff flags instead of manual GitHub fetches to preview and merge upstream component changes while preserving local modifications.

nodes.label: Base UI Class-String & Data-Attribute Rewrites
nodes.rationale: Maps Radix data-[state=...] selectors, keyframe animation classes, and --radix-* CSS variables to Base UI presence attributes (data-open, data-checked), data-starting-style/data-ending-style transitions, and simplified CSS custom properties.

nodes.label: Consumer Call-Site Prop Changes
nodes.rationale: Documents breaking call-site prop changes across app code when migrating from Radix to Base UI, including asChild to render prop, array-based Accordion/ToggleGroup values, and eventDetails callback arguments.

nodes.label: Disclosure & Toggle Family Props Mapping
nodes.rationale: Covers prop, part, data-attribute, and CSS variable mappings for accordion, collapsible, tabs, toggle, toggle-group, and toolbar primitives.

nodes.label: Display, Utility & Form Primitives Mapping
nodes.rationale: Covers progress, scroll-area, separator, avatar, manager-driven toast, Form/Field/Fieldset split, and native HTML/CSS replacements for Label, AspectRatio, VisuallyHidden, and AccessibleIcon.

nodes.label: Form Controls Props Mapping
nodes.rationale: Covers select, checkbox, radio-group, switch, and slider migrations, including span-rendered form controls, decoupled indeterminate state, and slider Control/Track/Indicator hierarchy.

nodes.label: Menu Family Props Mapping
nodes.rationale: Covers dropdown-menu (Base UI Menu), context-menu, menubar, and navigation-menu migrations, including Portal > Positioner > Popup structure and SubmenuRoot/SubmenuTrigger parts.

nodes.label: Overlay Primitives Props Mapping
nodes.rationale: Covers dialog, alert-dialog, popover, tooltip, and hover-card (PreviewCard) migrations, replacing per-event outside/escape handlers with Root.onOpenChange eventDetails reasons and cancellation.

nodes.label: Migrate Radix UI to Base UI Skill
nodes.norm_label: migrate radix ui to base ui skill
nodes.rationale: Migrates shadcn wrappers, hand-rolled Radix compositions, and their consumers to @base-ui/react while keeping the project buildable at every step using golden-pair CLI/merge first and transformation engine second.

nodes.label: Universal Radix-to-Base UI Migration Patterns
nodes.rationale: Defines the cross-cutting coverage matrix, import rewrites, asChild to render/useRender patterns, Portal > Positioner > Popup positioning architecture, and explicit Positioner prop forwarding.

nodes.label: Shadcn Base UI Target Wrapper Shapes
nodes.norm_label: shadcn base ui target wrapper shapes
nodes.rationale: Documents golden-derived specifics for shadcn Base UI wrappers including ButtonPrimitive usage, Tooltip Arrow offsets, SubContent composition defaults, Select bare Root export, and inner-div Accordion panel animations.

nodes.label: Golden Pair Migration Strategy
nodes.rationale: Uses the shadcn registry's radix and base style variants as a three-way merge ancestor/target pair so user customizations survive while upstream Base UI idioms are applied reliably.

nodes.label: Progressive Strangler-Fig Migration Mode
nodes.rationale: Writes migrated components to <component>-base.tsx and repoints consumers one at a time before replacing the original file, ensuring the project stays buildable throughout incremental migration.
